post.title: SpaceX is gifting kids stock. Families can't sell it early
post.ig:
Kids are getting two SpaceX shares they can't refuse or sell early.
SpaceX will put one Class A share in every active Trump Account, and Elon Musk says he'll match it (CNBC, Nov 25). Thursday night he posted he'll donate another share every year.
At Wednesday's $127.44 close, two shares are worth about $255. Musk says SpaceX's share is due in December (subject to approvals) and his in June 2027.
The catch: families can't refuse gifted stock and generally can't sell it until the earlier of 5 years or the end of the year the child turns 17.
Sources: CNBC (Nov 25 and Nov 27), SpaceX, White House, TrumpAccounts.gov via CNBC.
News and education, not financial advice.
